senses.gloss: (מאישא, מיאשא) pr. n. m. Mesha (= משחא, v. Nöld. Mand. Gr., p. 64), name of several persons.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 13b">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ר׳ מאיר</he> … <he>אלא מיישא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="N00256"><he>נהוראי</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), v. <cite ref="M00031"><he>מֵאִיר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:6">Peah II, 6</cite> <he>מישא</he> Y. ed. (Ms. M. <he>מיי׳</he>; ed. <he>מיא׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); <cite ref="Nazir 56b">Naz. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מיא׳</he>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:3:10">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:1:7">Y. Maasr. V, 51ᵈ</cite> top.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:2:8">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:9:4">Y. Ber. II, end, 5ᵈ</cite> <cite ref="J00451"><he>יסא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).—Ib. 4ᶜ bot. M., grandson of R. Joshua b. Levi.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:1:10">Y. Sabb. I, 2ᶜ</cite> top.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 9:3:8">Y. Naz. IX, 57ᵈ</cite> bot. M., son of R. Jeremiah.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:1:12">Y. Pes. IV, 30ᵈ</cite> top <he>בני מ׳</he> members of the Mesha family.
